learning_objective: 🎯 Break free from standard drawings like the usual 'v-shaped birds and corner sun' to create unique and imaginative artworks!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: For a long time, we all drew the same square house with a triangle roof. Changing the typical picture means using your own creative ideas to draw things in a brand new, unique way that tells your special story.
Perspective is all about where you are looking from. Instead of drawing a tree from the front, imagine what a tree looks like if you are an ant looking up, or a bird looking down!
The foreground is the part of the picture closest to you, making things look big. The background is far away, so things look much smaller. Playing with these makes your drawing feel deep and real.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Ant's Eye View Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Lie down on the floor of your room or garden and look up. Draw exactly what you see from this low angle, making the objects near you look giant!

quick_recap: ⭐ Challenge yourself to stop drawing the same basic shapes for nature and houses.
⭐ Try changing your angle or view to make everyday scenes look surprisingly different.
⭐ Adding a detailed foreground and background gives your artwork exciting depth.
⭐ Your artwork is special when it comes from your own unique imagination!
